title: A compactifyable scheme mapping to a separated finite type scheme has a compactification over the target
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism f : X -> Y of schemes over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base S with Y separated and of finite type over S and X compactifyable over S, the scheme X has a compactification over Y (statement lines 9386-9392). The proof is short but it must choose the right ambient construction: starting from a compactification j : X -> Xbar over S, one takes the scheme theoretic image Xbar' of the pair (j, f) inside the fibre product Xbar x_S Y, which is proper over Y as a base change of the proper Xbar -> S (proof lines 9395-9400). The open immersion property needs the separatedness of Y: the diagonal-like map (1, f) : X -> X x_S Y is a closed immersion by the semi-diagonal lemma, so the partial-section lemma applied to s = (j, f) and to the projection Xbar x_S Y -> Xbar gives that X -> Xbar' is an open immersion (proof lines 9400-9406). Recognising that the two ingredients are the properness of the base change and the closedness of the semi-diagonal is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
